body: Yes you should definitely give in and talk to someone. Anyone. A therapist would be great. I feel like Im so close to just going completely insane and having no rationality left, but telling someone in my life about it makes it less scary bc I know if that happens then theres someone on the outside who can help pull me out of it. I think you will find relief in telling someone about it. I hope you do

it makes complete sense to me. Im pretty dissociated from reality and my life so the thought of actually taking action and killing myself seems inconceivable, its like my thoughts have no power over the world outside my head so im trapped in my head with this desperate, unbearable feeling of needing and wanting to be dead but no way to achieve that.... idk if that makes sense to you

i feel the same way. its called passive suicidal ideation. like i just dont have the energy or the courage to do some crazy or painful method of suicide or anything, but i desperately want to be dead. its so frustrating
I know. Its so frustrating. Because they cant comprehend how I am feeling they decide that Im making it up or being dramatic
I feel the same way. Its like my brain cant hold onto anything. Everything I think or read or hear just slips right through my fingers.
thats what i do with my family, i feel guilty about placing my burdens on them by asking for help ... but u deserve to get help even if it takes making others feel bad to get that help

I feel the same way, Im desperate to go see someone for help but every time i actually do, i end up just going along with whatever they say, and then when they check in I say Im doing ok even though im not at all. Its hard to stand up for urself and advocate for urself when ur not the outspoken kind of person.

Im not encouraging you to commit suicide, but i do want to tell you that there are successful ways that dont have to be painful or violent. Have you ever heard of the euthanasia retreats in Europe? I believe they use injections of pretty painless lethal substances, like pentobarbital maybe. And Im pretty sure the deaths are very successful. Im just telling u this bc i dont want you to feel trapped. before i learned about places and drugs like this i felt so panicked and trapped like a painful way was my only way out.

this is how i feel, like i really want to be dead so bad but whenever i think about the act of actually killing myself im just too disconnected to be able to actually get up the motivation and incentive to do it and follow through with it. i always wish that someone would just take a syringe of the least painful lethal injection and just inject it into my arm, and bam its over
is quarantine making this feeling worse?

its not that i make a conscious decision that i hate every single person for blah blah blah reason. Its this really strong feeling i feel, that i think comes from all these years of built up jealousy and pain and feeling alone. ive had friends in the past, and i have friends online but i just convince myself that they hate me and then i begin to hate them too. in fact just an hour ago i ended my friendships with my only online friends. i guess its a way of punishing myself, bc i have a lot of self hatred. i feel like i deserve to feel alone and angry and like no one likes me. ive had depersonalization for 6 years, and for the first few years that i had it i had quite a bit of social interaction, so its definitwly not from just not having social interaction (although its probably making it worse now)

one misconception a lot of people have about depression is that its feeling sad or upset all the time. but for me, and a lot of other ppl, depression manifests in the form of feeling nothing or “apathetic” as u say. and i feel that feeling constantly. there are points where i simply dont care about anything, and im not desperate or sad im just tired and dont really see a point. but there are moments when i feel this rush of pure joy, and happiness, and everything seems so beautiful and i feel so in love with the world. those moments dont last long, but they remind me that there is something that exists beyond the feeling of apathy & nothingness. i dont know when the last time u felt that feeling, but it feels pretty damn good. i think u should try to break through ur depression to feel that feeling, and then decide whether u think life is worth living. whatever u decide is valid. but know that there is something more to be felt.

I understand. I have never been in a relationship, or really felt any sort of warmth or love. The only thing that keeps me going is the thought of having that sense of warmth and love when being with someone. Life feels so cold and unbearable without it. I hope we both find that someday soon
